reddit.title: Introducing Ranks That Turn and March
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest development update for Provincia! In our recent changes, we've refined how formations move and interact in battle. No more teleporting soldiers or confusing march orders. Instead, units will now turn and march in a more realistic manner, maintaining their structure and spacing. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
